title.en: A journey on a map: from Lwów to Santa Fe

attribution: © 2026 Mateusz Wojczal. Code: MIT. Text: CC BY 4.0. Map: Natural Earth (public domain) through world-atlas (ISC); coordinates from Wikidata (CC0). Placeholder content until the fact sheet is cleared.

text.en: Placeholder text: the journey starts in Lwów, today Lviv in Ukraine. The map shows present-day country borders; no historical borders are drawn. The inset is a schematic plan of the centre, not to scale. The notes about this stop are filled in when the fact sheet has been cleared.

Placeholder text: the second stop is Princeton, New Jersey. The line shows the straight-line route over the globe from the previous stop. The notes about this stop are filled in when the fact sheet has been cleared.
Placeholder text: the third stop is Cambridge, Massachusetts, the home of Harvard. The notes about this stop are filled in when the fact sheet has been cleared.
Placeholder text: the fourth stop is Madison, Wisconsin. The notes about this stop are filled in when the fact sheet has been cleared.
Placeholder text: the fifth stop is Los Alamos, New Mexico. The notes about this stop are filled in when the fact sheet has been cleared.
Placeholder text: the sixth stop is Boulder, Colorado. The notes about this stop are filled in when the fact sheet has been cleared.
Placeholder text: the last stop is Santa Fe, New Mexico. The notes about this stop are filled in when the fact sheet has been cleared.

a11y.keyboard: The map is a picture; every stop is also a native button in the list under it, and the step card has Back and Next. Each leg is described in text (the two places and the distance).
a11y.notes: With reduced motion the map jumps to each stop instead of flying. The map shows present-day borders only and says so.
